description.en: concrete pump rubber spring φ235 is restated under Viscosity. The φ235 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: polyurethane only. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.

h1.en: The printed concrete pump rubber spring φ235 line, ordered as Viscosity orders its page
h1.zh: 已印的concrete pump rubber spring φ235，按《黏度》的页面次序来写

directAnswer.en: Viscosity is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump rubber spring φ235 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. The φ235 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: polyurethane only. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
directAnswer.zh: 《黏度》是百科页。concrete pump rubber spring φ235仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 φ235 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：只有聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

body.en: Read “Etymology” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. The page lists φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. Rubber rows are φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230 and φ260. Polyurethane rows are φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. This φ235 row is polyurethane only. Unit: piece. Hardness and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A split or integral piston at φ235, where that size exists, is a different product page and a different unit. φ235 is on the spring page only. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 把“词源”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 页面列出 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。橡胶行是 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ260。聚氨酯行是 φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。φ235 这一行是只有聚氨酯。单位：个。硬度和寿命缺失。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 若分体或整体活塞也有 φ235，那是另一张产品页，单位也不同。φ235 只在弹簧页上。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Definitions” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write rubber spring or polyurethane spring, φ235, and the quantity in pieces, matching the material row above. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “来源章节：Definitions”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 按上面的材料行写橡胶弹簧或聚氨酯弹簧、φ235 和个数。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Read “Momentum transport” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. The φ235 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: polyurethane only. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 把“来源章节：Momentum transport”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 φ235 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：只有聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 没有印出的格子保持不印。
